long_biography.plain_text:
Emiliano Suárez de la Villa grew up in the small Bilbao workshop founded by his father, Emiliano Suárez Faffián. When both parents died in a road accident, he and his brother Benito inherited a fragile business while still in their twenties. Years spent working in the shop gave them the practical grounding to carry the company through a difficult succession.

The brothers expanded beyond Bilbao, opening in Madrid and developing Suárez into a Spanish luxury-jewellery house with its own collections and distinctive retail spaces. They travelled internationally to select precious materials and built the family name around craftsmanship, quality and contemporary design. Later generations joined the group, and Emiliano and Benito remained co-presidents while supporting the transfer of executive leadership to their nephew Juan.

proposed_details.existing_value:
The Sanlorenzo SX112 yacht Moscardon was delivered in 2023. According to records from the classification society RINA, the yacht is registered in the name of its owner, Emiliano Suárez de la Valle of Spain.

Emiliano Suárez de la Valle is a Spanish jeweller and a prominent member of the founding family behind Suárez, one of Spain’s leading luxury jewellery houses. The company was founded in Bilbao in 1943 by his parents, Emiliano Suárez Faffián and Sara de la Valle. After their deaths in a car accident in 1974, Emiliano and his brother Benito Suárez de la Valle assumed control of the business, guiding its evolution from a small workshop into a well-established, multi-store brand with a presence across Spain and internationally.

Suárez remains a family-owned company, with third-generation involvement. This includes his nephew, Emiliano Suárez Pascual, who previously served as Strategic Marketing Director and played a key role in developing the brand’s younger line, Aristocrazy, before later leaving the company to pursue new ventures.

Given the yacht’s name and its registration under the Spanish flag, it is reasonable to conclude that the Ferretti yacht Moscardon is also associated with Emiliano Suárez de la Valle.
